title: Openscope ATC simulator airport load list schema

airport.description: A data block for a single airport

level.description: Difficulty level based on the traffic

name.description: Official English name of the airport, according to Jeppesen charts

premium.description: Whether airport meets premium standards, according to the airport standards document

disabled.description: (Optional) Prevents airport from being listed within the game

iata.description: (Optional) IATA airport code in uppercase; may be an empty string when the airport has none

country.description: (Optional) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the airport in uppercase

generated.description: (Optional) True for airports produced by tools/data-pipeline (OurAirports + OpenFlights data) rather than hand-authored from official charts
